newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins DM 300 mln GSM 1800 deal.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins DM 300 mln GSM 1800 deal.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Wednesday it had won a deal worth over 300 million marks for the delivery and installation of a base station system for German VIAG Interkom's VIAG/F GSM 1800 network.
"The contract exceeds 300 million German marks and ranks among the biggest system agreements of the year," Nokia said.
"This deal establishes Nokia's position as the leading base station supplier on the European market," Nokia said, adding the contract covered the first phase of the network roll-out.
VIAG Interkom's GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) 1800 network would be operational by mid-1998.
VIAG Interkom is a consortium formed by German diversified utility Viag AG, British Telecom and Norwegian Telenor.
"The deal also positions Nokia as a key supplier to the global operators, BT and Telenor," it said.
